tasks.title: Supervisor trigger distance
tasks.statement: Two vehicles are closing, each at **{v} m/s**. Telemetry delay is **{d1} s**, decision **{d2} s**, braking **{b} s**, and the combined position error of the two vehicles is **{e} m**. Estimate the minimum trigger distance (m), assuming constant closing speed for this whole time.
tasks.solution: Closing speed is 2v; the distance covered during (delays + braking) plus position errors.
